note: Scoring rectangles chosen on 2026-11-24 from the pit-free CHM, the 2025 and 2021 photos and detector-neutral measurements (tools/tree-pipeline/photo/window-measure.mjs; window-measure.json), before any detector under test ran. Both routings, both laser campaigns (21C031: C12, C13, C17, H8, H9; 20C028: the rest), the castle park and churchyard (C1, C11, C15, H6, H12, H16), closed stands (C3, C4, C5, C12, C13, C16, C18, H1, H3, H4, H5, H8, H10), edges and groups, single and avenue trees (C2, C7, C8, H2, H6), shores (H3, H14) and building surroundings (C11, C15, C16, H12, H16). No held-out window is within 15 m of a calibration window. Draft rectangles dropped before declaration, on the contact sheets: a conifer stand west of Castle 18 thinned since the 2020 laser, two clearings felled since it (Castle 11 and Castle 7 north), single trees by the Stadium 10 tee felled since it, a stream thicket and a planted willow stand whose crowns no source separates, a castle terrace without trees and a shed yard. The sample is the ground as the laser and the 2025 photo both show it.

declaredBeforeScoring.rule: agent (Claude), 2026-11-24: two detectors are tuned in order on the calibration windows only: r1 typed (the type-aware detector, coordinate descent from TYPED_DEFAULTS) and r2 refined (the r1 settings, suppressed tops taken back only on their own laser cone and apex and a separate crown in the photo). No fused or split round: their photo crowns come from the GPU stage photo-detect, which is not run on this ground. A v2 grid-search round was planned first and stopped unfinished, before any lock or score, to meet the delivery time; the sample did not change. Both rounds read this one sample (r2 carries it verbatim). No evaluation window is scored until both locks exist; then round r2's benchmark scores them once, together with the published first generation (machine-v1 records, with and without its stand trees) and the 1 m detector. The detector put forward is the one with the higher held-out F1, unless its held-out precision is more than 0.03 below the other's (then the other); a tie goes to the simpler r1. If it reaches precision and recall of at least 0.9 on at least 30 scored crowns the gate passes; otherwise the gate is missed and that is what is reported.
declaredBeforeScoring.strata: recall by stratum (isolated, group, edge, closed), by type and by height is reported with the totals, and per campaign (20C028, 21C031), for the park and building windows (H6, H12, H16) and for the shore windows (H3, H14)
declaredBeforeScoring.secondary: the decided candidates (after the holds, the bank rule and the reviews) are scored on the held-out windows as a secondary number, which decides nothing; the published first generation (published-individuals+stands) and the 1 m detector are scored alongside and decide nothing
